script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
source /opt/afdo_agent/scripts/common.sh
assert_board rpi4
MODE=${1:?}; case "$MODE" in ff-a|ff-b|spike-c) ;; *) exit 2;; esac
new_run
complete=0; monitor=; hashpid=; mapspid=
cleanup() {
 rc=$?; trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
 (( rc != 0 || complete == 1 )) || rc=1
 for p in "$monitor" "$hashpid" "$mapspid"; do [[ -z $p ]] || { kill -TERM "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; }; done
 [[ ! -p $RUN/frames.pipe ]] || rm "$RUN/frames.pipe"
 printf 'EXIT %s\nALL-END %s %s\n' "$rc" "$(date -Ins)" "$([[ $rc == 0 ]] && echo OK || echo FAILED)" >> "$RUN/status"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 129' HUP
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
mkdir "$RUN/calibration" "$RUN/proc" "$RUN/telemetry"
getconf CLK_TCK > "$RUN/clk_tck"
calibrate() {
 local stage=$1 cpu path online
 for path in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu[0-9]*; do
  cpu=${path##*cpu}; [[ $cpu =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
  online=1; [[ ! -r $path/online ]] || online=$(cat "$path/online")
  [[ $online == 1 ]] || continue
  TIMEFORMAT="CAL_TIME real=%R user=%U sys=%S"
  { time LC_ALL=C LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/afdo_agent/lib taskset -c "$cpu" "${PERF[@]}" stat -x ';' -e cycles,task-clock -o "$RUN/calibration/$stage-cpu$cpu.csv" -- /opt/afdo_agent/variants/spike-thumb-S/bin/eval-spike 100000; } >"$RUN/calibration/$stage-cpu$cpu.stdout" 2>"$RUN/calibration/$stage-cpu$cpu.stderr"
 done
}
proc_snapshot() {
 local file=$1 p pid
 { date -Ins; cat /proc/vmstat
   if [[ -r $RUN/target.pid ]]; then
    pid=$(cat "$RUN/target.pid")
    for p in /proc/"$pid"/stat /proc/"$pid"/task/*/stat; do
      [[ ! -r $p ]] || { printf 'PROC %s\n' "$p"; cat "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; }
    done
   fi
   for pid in $DAEMONS; do [[ ! -r /proc/$pid/stat ]] || { printf 'DAEMON /proc/%s/stat\n' "$pid"; cat /proc/$pid/stat 2>/dev/null || true; }; done
 } >"$file"
}
DAEMONS=$(ps -eo pid,comm | awk '$2=="reclaimd" || $2=="resourced" || $2 ~ /^kswapd/ {print $1}')
[[ -n $DAEMONS ]] || { echo 'No kernel reclaim task found'; exit 2; }
calibrate before
case "$MODE" in ff-*) ID=ffmpeg-thumb-S;; *) ID=spike-thumb-S;; esac
load_variant /opt/afdo_agent/eval-manifest.tsv "$ID"
if [[ $OBJECT == ffmpeg ]]; then
 mkfifo "$RUN/frames.pipe"; sha256sum "$RUN/frames.pipe" >"$RUN/decoded.sha256" & hashpid=$!
 exec 8>"$RUN/frames.pipe"
 command_for /opt/afdo_agent/media/bbb_720p_h264_60s.mp4 "$RUN/frames.pipe"
else command_for 1000000 "$RUN/frames.pipe"; fi
watch_maps "$RUN/target.pid" "$RUN/target.maps" "$TARGET" & mapspid=$!
proc_snapshot "$RUN/proc.before"
(
 i=0
 while :; do
   proc_snapshot "$RUN/proc/$i.txt"
   snapshot "$RUN/telemetry/$i.txt"
   i=$((i+1)); sleep 1
 done
) & monitor=$!
LAUNCH=(/bin/bash -c 'TIMEFORMAT="TARGET_TIME real=%R user=%U sys=%S"; { time /bin/bash -c '\''printf "%s\n" "$$" >"$1"; shift; exec "$@"'\'' _ "$@"; }' _ "$RUN/target.pid" "${CMD[@]}")
STAT=("${PERF[@]}" stat -x ';' -e cycles:u,cycles:k,instructions:u,task-clock -o "$RUN/perf-stat.csv" -- "${LAUNCH[@]}")
printf '%q ' "${STAT[@]}" > "$RUN/command"; printf '\n' >> "$RUN/command"
set +e
if [[ $MODE == ff-a ]]; then
 LC_ALL=C "${PERF[@]}" record --buildid-mmap -e cycles -c 1000003 -o "$RUN/perf.data" -- "${STAT[@]}" >"$RUN/workload.stdout" 2>"$RUN/workload.stderr"
else
 LC_ALL=C "${STAT[@]}" >"$RUN/workload.stdout" 2>"$RUN/workload.stderr"
fi
rc=$?; set -e
printf 'WORKLOAD_EXIT %s\n' "$rc" >"$RUN/status"
proc_snapshot "$RUN/proc.after"
kill -TERM "$monitor"; wait "$monitor" 2>/dev/null || true; monitor=
[[ $rc == 0 ]] || exit "$rc"
exec 8>&-
if [[ -n $hashpid ]]; then wait "$hashpid"; hashpid=; fi
wait "$mapspid"; mapspid=
if [[ $MODE == ff-a ]]; then
 "${PERF[@]}" evlist -v -i "$RUN/perf.data" >"$RUN/evlist.txt" 2>"$RUN/evlist.stderr"
 "${PERF[@]}" buildid-list -i "$RUN/perf.data" >"$RUN/buildid-list.txt" 2>"$RUN/buildid-list.stderr"
 awk -v id="$TARGET_ID" -v path="$TARGET" '$1==id && $2==path {found=1} END {exit !found}' "$RUN/buildid-list.txt"
fi
calibrate after
finish_run
complete=1
